How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

Customers say

Customers find the knife set to be of good quality, well-made, and appreciate its appearance, with one customer noting its clean, pricey look. The functionality is positive, with scissors performing beautifully, and customers like the included sharpener tool. Durability receives mixed feedback - while they hold up well in the dishwasher, some report chipped cutting edges after less than a year. Cutting performance and sharpness also get mixed reviews, with some saying they cut nicely while others report difficulty cutting vegetables and fruits, and while the knives come sharp, they need frequent honing to maintain their edge. The rust resistance is concerning, with multiple customers reporting rust issues.

    ve been using this knife set for a little while now, and overall I’m really happy with it—especially for the price. It comes with everything you need for everyday cooking, which made it perfect for me starting fresh in the kitchen.

    The knives are sharp right out of the box and handle basic tasks like cutting vegetables, meat, and bread really well. I also like that it includes a sharpener and a block to keep everything organized.

    The only thing I would say is that they may need to be sharpened more often with regular use, but that’s expected at this price point.

    Overall, it’s a solid, affordable set that gets the job done and looks nice on the counter.

  • 14-piece knife set incluedes: (1) 8'' Chef's knife, (1) 8'' Slicing knife, (1) 8'' Bread knife, (1) 5.5'' Utility knife, (1) 3.5'' paring knife, (6) 4.5'' steak knife, (1) 8'' kitchen scissors, (1) 8''sharpener, (1) knife block
  • High carbon stainless-steel blades for precision results and lasting sharpness
  • Traditional, full tang, triple-riveted ergonomic knife handles offer pleasant weight for better balance and control
  • For best results, wash knives by hand and dry immediately; wipe the block with a damp cloth and air-dry upside down at least once per month
